Which research degree is right for you?
Compare research degree options and find the pathway that best matches your goals, interests and preferred way of studying.

Explore your research degree options
From a Master’s by Research to a PhD, discover the pathway that aligns with your research ambitions.
PhD (Doctor of Philosophy)
Best for: Students wanting to conduct original research and become experts in their field.
Duration: 4 years full time.
Outcome: Doctor of Philosophy (PhD).
Learn more arrow_forward
Master’s by Research
Best for: Students wanting advanced research training before a PhD or research-focused career.
Duration: 2 years full time.
Outcome: Master’s degree.
Learn more arrow_forward
Collaborative Doctoral Research Degree Program
Best for: Students wanting international research experience, joint supervision and collaboration with a partner university.
Duration: 4 years full time.
Outcome: Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) awarded by UTS and a partner university.
Learn more arrow_forward
Visiting Research Student Program
Best for: International students seeking short-term research experience and collaboration opportunities at UTS.
Duration: Flexible.
Outcome: International research experience and professional networks (no UTS degree awarded).
